title: Agent Admission Apply — payload
description: A candidate agent opens an admission application: a canonicalised statement of understanding whose digest deterministically draws the criteria the agent will be challenged on.

agent.description: VID of the candidate agent. MUST equal the document issuer.

policyRef.description: Reference to the governing policy the agent claims to understand.

submissionDigest.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical submission bytes (recursive key-sort, no insignificant whitespace).

submissionRef.description: Optional retrieval reference for the submission bytes.

applicationId.description: Gate-authority-assigned identifier of the opened application, carried by every later task in the ceremony.

respondBy.description: Deadline for the agent's answers; the understanding gate refuses late responses.
